''See also: [[General Teach Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Jarelys Teach]] is the Head of the [[Imperial Guard]] and a high-ranking General who rose to power by suppressing a rebellion. Known for her immense physical strength and intimidating presence, she often wears red-and-black plated armor and carries [[Tyrfang]], a legendary executioner's blade that predates [[The Empire|the Empire]]. The sword possesses a dark, noxious power and a heavy aura of intent that can be felt from a distance. [[Teach]] is characterized by her cold, penetrating gaze and a reputation for being a brutal warrior, though she has expressed internal conflict regarding her history of killing [[Imperial]] citizens to maintain [[The Empire|the Empire]]'s stability. Her loyalty has been a subject of speculation, as she transitioned from serving the true Emperor to a lesser successor. Throughout various conflicts, she has demonstrated extreme combat prowess, utilizing a winged [[Kameira]] for travel and engaging in high-stakes battles against [[Elders]] and other powerful figures. Despite her savage appearance in combat, she is noted for being an honest individual who is neither a liar nor a traitor.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|This woman wears armor consisting of red and black plates, including her arms. She has pale hair that is cut close to her scalp.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a military leader and the Head of the [[Imperial Guard]], she possesses hostile intent. She is a figure whom the Emperor cannot trust with certain details.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|She wields the sword [[Tyrfang]] and utilizes a Windwatcher. Additionally, she can be contacted through a chain of whistle signals.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Head of the Imperial Guard}} ===
